props.gloss_en: Shmuel ruled on rider and leader -- one acquires, one does not; which is which was lost in transmission
does the rider (who grasps the animal) prevail over the leader (who makes it walk)?
in Shmuel's text of the kilayim mishna it is the RABBIS who exempt the wagon-sitter (the printed text gives that to R' Meir)
Rav Yehuda's inference: a plain rider does not acquire, all the more so a rider alongside a leader
holding the reins of an ownerless animal does not acquire it
Rav Huna: reins acquire when handed over by a fellow person; for a find or a convert's estate they acquire nothing
(entertained) our mishna (rider and leader both acquire) must be the Rabbis -- so a rider acquires
deflection: the mishna's 'rider' also drives the animal with his feet -- a second kind of leading
first tanna: pulling a camel or driving a donkey (or one pulling and one driving) acquires -- 'in this manner'
R' Yehuda: only the animal's OWN mode acquires -- pulling for a camel, driving for a donkey
(entertained) if 'in this manner' excludes the reversed modes, the first tanna's position simply IS R' Yehuda's
the positions are distinct: they differ over exactly one mode that does not acquire
version 1: the mode the first tanna concedes does not acquire is pulling a donkey
version 2: the conceded mode is driving a camel
Rav Ashi's text of the reins baraita: the rider-driver acquires the donkey and its halter; the reins-holder only what is in his hand; the rest neither
R' Abbahu: keep the baraita as taught -- the reins-holder acquires because he could yank them to himself
R' Eliezer: riding acquires in the field, leading in the city
Rav Kahana: riding fails in the city because people do not normally ride there
resolution: R' Eliezer's ruling concerns a sale, where the seller said 'acquire the way people acquire' (with carve-outs: public domain, an important person, a woman, a shameless one)
R' Elazar: does pulling the animal acquire the vessels on its back?
Rava: the animal is a walking courtyard, and a walking courtyard acquires nothing (and what would not acquire moving does not acquire standing)
the redactor's ruling: the vessels are acquired only when the animal is bound
which of Shmuel's two rulings attaches to which case (rakhuv or manhig) -- the mapping itself

questions.gloss_en: rider against leader: which acquires? Every תא שמע is deflected; no verdict is recorded
